evals.prompt: Is this SMILES string valid? CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O — I copied it out of a PDF and I want to be sure nothing got mangled before I put it in the paper.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Checks brackets, atom symbols, bond tokens, ring closures and valence separately; Reports a per-check VALID/INVALID line and an overall RESULT; States that a VALID verdict is syntax-only and not a chemistry judgement.
expectations: Checks brackets, atom symbols, bond tokens, ring closures and valence separately
Reports a per-check VALID/INVALID line and an overall RESULT
States that a VALID verdict is syntax-only and not a chemistry judgement

evals.prompt: A model generated a list of candidate molecules as SMILES strings and some of them look mangled — unbalanced parentheses, ring digits that never close. Can you check the strings parse before I load the file?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Checks each string in the batch and reports how many are valid; Names the offending token and its character position for each failure; Does not silently repair a broken string.
expectations: Checks each string in the batch and reports how many are valid
Names the offending token and its character position for each failure
Does not silently repair a broken string

evals.prompt: Sanity-check the smiles column in this dataset before I trust the structures quoted in the patent claim.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Extracts each SMILES string with its source field or line; Runs the structural checks and flags strings that fail; Recommends re-sourcing or dropping failed strings rather than fixing them.
expectations: Extracts each SMILES string with its source field or line
Runs the structural checks and flags strings that fail
Recommends re-sourcing or dropping failed strings rather than fixing them

evals.prompt: The paper says caffeine has the molecular formula C8H10N4O2 and a molecular weight of 194 g/mol. Does that check out?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Checks the prose claim — name against formula and molecular weight — rather than parsing a structure string; Does not run a SMILES syntax check.
expectations: Checks the prose claim — name against formula and molecular weight — rather than parsing a structure string
Does not run a SMILES syntax check

evals.prompt: Check that the DOIs and arXiv IDs in this reference list are well formed and actually resolve before the manuscript goes out.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Validates citation identifiers, not molecular structures; Does not attempt a structural chemistry check.
expectations: Validates citation identifiers, not molecular structures
Does not attempt a structural chemistry check
